responsibility: Implements the tree-level loop if-conversion pass used primarily to prepare loops for vectorization. It analyzes whether a loop’s control flow can be predicated, may version loops to preserve profitability or legality, propagates predicates across blocks, converts PHIs and assignments into conditional forms, merges loop blocks into a single predicated body, performs localized cleanup/CSE/DCE afterward, and updates CFG, SSA, loop, and scalar-evolution state for downstream vector and loop optimizers.
same_name_distinction: Implements the loop if-conversion engine declared by gcc/tree-if-conv.h. Unlike the header’s single exported entry point, this file contains the legality/versioning logic, predicate propagation, PHI and block merging, and pass driver that rewrites loop CFG and SSA for predicated form.
